name: Rukiga
region: Ankole, south-western Uganda (Mbarara, Bushenyi, Ntungamo, Ibanda)
translator_note: Everyday spoken Runyankore in the standard Runyakitara orthography, addressed in the singular (o-/-awe) the way a Mbarara advert talks to one person. The four verbs keep the earlier STR renderings (Shagara, Gaba, Pangisa, Tuma); Explore was moved from the duplicated Shagara to Zengyerera. App vocabulary with no settled word (app, link, code, sandbox, endpoint, API key, adapter, plug-in, permits) uses the common loan or a short paraphrase, and Hustle/Hustle Mode is kept as a product name; those keys are listed under uncertain.

strings.page.p.ug_speaks_the_languages: UG negamba endimi za Uganda, ez'ekicweka, n'ez'abagyenyi. Toorana yaawe; byona nibikuratira.
strings.top.p.one_app_that_quotes: App emwe erikukworeka ebiiro by'orugyendo rwona aha katare ka Uganda hamwe, ekagaba orugyendo rw'omuhanda ngu omuhendo gwa Prado gugwe aha kicweka kya kana, ekakupangisa emotoka obu oyenda kuhika gye, kandi ekakukwatira paaka obwikirizo butakahwaireho. Oshashura nk'oku Kampala eshashura: sente z'aha simu.
strings.doorRiderSub: Kwata entebe, gyeragyeranisa buri rugyendo, teekateeka wiikendi.
strings.doorDriverSub: Gamba ahu omanyire gye. Engyendo ezaashashuriirwe nizikwija.
strings.top.div.prototype_v1_every_price: Prototype v1 · buri muhendo n'okuteebereza okuruga omu model eyaashohozibwa · okushashura kuri omu sandbox y'okugyezaho · tihaine ekiri hanu ekiine layisensi nk'obuheereza
strings.compare.h2.every_ride_on_the: Buri rugyendo oruri aha katare, aha screen emwe, birikukurikirana omu biiro.
strings.compare.summary.what_choosing_badly_cost: Okutoorana kubi nikukuhwera ki <small>empinduka y'ebiiro omu katare aha rugyendo oru</small>
strings.compare.summary.the_atlas_every_way: Atlas · buri muhanda gw'okugyenda, ameeza emwe <small>endege, basi, amaizi, eteeni, emotoka za Signature, aha kuraara, n'amazima aha mbeera ya buri kimwe</small>
strings.compare.p.book_on_ug_where: Kwata aha UG ahu omuhanda guriho, Teera esimu ahu gutariho, Kiri aha rukaraari ahabw'okukimanya, Neija aha birikwombekwa. Ebiiro biteebereziibwe kandi nibikigamba.
strings.stage.div.the_virtual_stage_seats: Siteegi y'aha mutimbagano · entebe zibanza kwijura, emotoka ereije
strings.stage.p.like_a_matatu_stage: Nk'aha siteegi ya taagisi, emotoka neegyenda yaijura nari eshaaha yahika. Ekitari nka siteegi, oteera sente omu murongo ori aha sofa yaawe, omuhendo gw'entebe nigugwa abanywani baawe baayeyongyera, kandi dereeva orikugitwara aba yaagambire ngu omuhanda ogwo agumanyire gye.
strings.stage.summary.where_stages_fill_fastest: Ahu siteegi zirikwijura bwangu <small>Pulse · entebe ezaashashuriirwe n'emihanda ei badereeva bamanyire, omu buri tauni</small>
strings.stage.summary.buses_on_this_corridor: Basi z'omu muhanda ogu <small>ekyokugarukiraho, hamwe na siteegi</small>
strings.stage.p.every_corridor_also_has: Buri muhanda gwine na basi. Gyeragyeranisa eshaaha z'okurugaho za kampuni zona, reeba paaka ei orikurugamu, kandi okwate aha UG ahu kampuni erikwemera okukwatira aha mutimbagano. Ahu etarikukikora, nitukikugambira, tukakuha enamba y'okuteera esimu, omu mwanya gwa button etarikukora.
strings.stage.p.every_rental_with_driver: Buri kupangisa na dereeva na buri rugyendo rw'okugabana rwine oku rurikugaruka. Orugyendo rw'okuza rwakwatwa, entebe z'okugaruka zitandika kuguzibwa.
strings.stage.summary.post_a_trip_of: Teekaho orugyendo rwawe, nari oreebe omuhendo gw'entebe <small>Gaba · abanywani baawe, omuhendo gw'amazima gw'omuhanda gugabiibwe omu ntebe</small>
strings.stage.h3.offer_a_seat_or: Ha entebe, nari oreebe omuhendo entebe egishemereire
strings.stage.p.posted_trips_live_only: Engyendo ezaateekwaho ziguma omu browser egi yonka okuhitsya obu waataahamu. Gaba negyendera aha muhanda Pool app eyaateraho: akawunti ezaahamibwa n'esimu, chat y'orugyendo, okuhaana amaani empande zombi, hamwe n'ebibiina ngu ogyende n'abantu abu omanyireho kakye.
strings.rent.p.self_drive_by_the: Ovugye wenka aha izooba, na dereeva aha shaaha, nari emotoka za Signature obu okuhika nikwo kikuru. Omuhendo n'ogwa buri muntu obu mwagugabana.
strings.deliver.h2.send_the_thing_any: Tuma ekintu. Kikye nari kihango, haihi nari hara.
strings.deliver.p.every_courier_in_town: Buri courier omu tauni aha screen emwe, bakurikiranisiibwe. Omu kyaro, ekipakiti kigyenda omu buuti y'emotoka ya siteegi aha kicweka kya kana ky'entebe, kandi omu bwire bw'okusharura, taagisi, pikapu nari rooli na dereeva.
strings.deliver.p.courier_rates_are_ug: Ebiiro bya courier n'okuteebereza kwa UG kuruga omu model eyaashohozibwa; 8 to 8 omu Jinja ekaihwa omu bihandiiko by'omutandisi kandi ebiiro byayo biteebereziibwe. Ekipakiti aha Siteegi n'omuhendo gwa UG yonyini: ekicweka kya kana ky'entebe aha siteegi egyo, gushashurwa dereeva hamwe n'entebe.
strings.explore.h2.the_whole_park_weekend: Wiikendi yona ey'omu paaka, enamba emwe.
strings.explore.p.park_entry_permits_vehicle: Okutaaha omu paaka, obwikirizo, ebiiro by'emotoka, lodge, sente za rolex n'omuhanda ogurikuzayo, bibariirwe abatuuze ba Afrika y'Oburugwa-izooba, abanyamahanga abatuura hanu n'abataayaayi. Abatuuze ba Afrika y'Oburugwa-izooba bashashura ebiiro bya Afrika y'Oburugwa-izooba.
strings.explore.summary.chain_a_whole_day: Teekateeka eizooba ryona <small>Hustle Mode · buri kicweka kibariirwe aha muhanda gw'omuhendo mukye kandi gw'obwengye; wallet n'enteekateeka biri omu sandbox</small>
strings.explore.div.ug_wallet_sandbox_balance: UG Wallet · sente z'okugyezaho, ti sente z'amazima
strings.drive.h2.say_where_you_are: Gamba ahu omanyire gye, rimwe. Emera emotoka ezijwire.
strings.drive.p.no_posting_no_waiting: Tiwaateekaho, tiwaarinda aha siteegi, tiwaaharuka. Comfort Map yaawe nikyo kintu kyonka eki orikureeberera: aha otuura, obwiha, emihanda, eshaaha, ebi otarikwemera. Engyendo ezaashashuriirwe ziija n'esente ziri omuriyo.
strings.drive.summary.where_demand_is_coming: Ahu abantu barikwenda okugyenda esande egi <small>Foresight · okusharura, ebibaho omu bishengye n'emikoro, esande omu maisho, omu buri kika ky'emotoka</small>
strings.drive.p.promise_to_be_there: Raganisa kubaho n'ekituro kikorwe buri muntu. Obwesigye nibworekwa aha buri kimanyiso; ebyanda n'ebiragiro okuhitsya obu okusharura okw'okubanza kubyegyesa.
strings.drive.span.confidence_is_shown_per: Obwesigye nibworekwa aha buri kimanyiso; ebyanda n'ebiragiro okuhitsya obu haabaho ebyaijwire eby'okwegyeraho.
strings.install.h2.the_site_is_the: Website nikwo app. Giteekeho, nari oshoome code.
strings.install.p.one_link_on_the: Link emwe aha mutimbagano n'aha simu: akawunti emwe, siteegi zimwe, Crest emwe aha screen y'omuka. Tihariho kuza omu store.
strings.install.p.scan_with_the_camera: Shooma na kamera. Code neeyigura link egi; taahamu n'enamba emwe kandi byona biri hanu.
strings.install.p.ride_pool_rent_deliver: Gyenda. Gabana. Pangisa. Tuma. Akatare k'entambura ka Uganda ahabw'abantu abaine ahu barikuza n'ebbaagyeti ei bashemereire kukuratira.
strings.modal.span.checkout_by_flutterwave_sandb: Okushashura kuri na Flutterwave · sandbox okuhitsya obu key y'amazima eteekwaho
strings.plugModal.label.api_key_or_token: API key nari token (eguma aha kyoma eki)
strings.railModal.span.booked_and_tracked_on: Rwakwatwa kandi nirukuratirwa aha UG. Omuhereza n'ow'okugyezaho omu prototype egi.
strings.railModal.div.reduce_motionno_opening_an: Kendeeza okunyeenyaTihariho kanyeenyo k'okutandika, tihariho obucweka nibutembeera
strings.railModal.div.underline_linksevery_link_: Taaho omurongo aha nyunguzoBuri nyunguzo ekutsigirweho omurongo, hatari rangi yonka
strings.railModal.p.ug_also_follows_your: UG nekuratira kandi enteekateeka z'ekyuma kyaawe ahabw'okukendeeza okunyeenya n'okutangaana, nekora n'ekisomesa-kirikusoma (ebiceerezo, oburanga n'ebiraga ebirikuhinduka), nokora byona n'akakiiboodo, kandi nehuriiriza ebiragiro by'eiraka omu kupeencira aha kanuni y'omushaija nari omu Cephable. Otugambire eki kirakukuhwera: hello@ug.example.
strings.ops.p.every_town_on_the: Buri tauni eri aha mapu n'omuhanda okuruga Kampala kandi n'esiteegi yaayo yonka. Ahu app y'omu kyaro erikukorera, UG neegiha ekicweka ky'aha muheru omu mwanya gw'okwebeiha ngu eriyo.
strings.ops.h2.maps_from_felt_climate: Mapu kuruga Felt. Emirimo y'obwire kuruga Infrared City. Eby'okweshemeza kuruga Tazama. Okukoresa otarikukwataho kuruga Cephable.
strings.ops.p.each_plug_in_is: Buri kyokwongyeraho n'adapter eine endpoint na key yaayo, ebiikirwe aha kyoma eki okuhitsya obu waataahamu. Kwatanisa kimwe kandi button ezirikuhikaana ziyaka omu Gabana, Zengyerera na Hustle Mode. Tihariho ekirikuruga omu UG hataine ekyokwongyeraho eki waayakiza.
strings.ops.h2.competitors_are_listed_on: Abavuganya bateekirweho n'ekigyendererwa. Orikugyenda orikwesiga okugyeragyeranisa agaruka ahabw'okugaba n'okupangisa.
strings.ops.p.ug_is_a_marketplace: UG n'akatare ekya kubanza. App z'okushaba emotoka zitunga okukwatwa okwaijwiremu kandi zitashashuriire kuronda abakasitoma. Abarikupangisa emotoka batunga abapangisa ba wiikendi abaakyebeirwe. Lodge zitunga ebibiina ebirikwija eizooba erimanyirwe. Badereeva batunga omuhanda ogwijwire batakarugireho.
strings.ops.p.verified_drivers_and_plates: Badereeva n'enamba z'emotoka ebyahamibwa, SOS omu rugyendo erikugaba ahu ori n'omuntu ou waatoorana, enkoofiira aha buri boda y'okugabana, na risiiti ya buri shiringi.
strings.ops.p.ten_percent_on_pool: Kimwe aha ikumi aha kugaba, omuhendo gumwe gw'okuteekaho aha kupangisa, okushashurwa buri sande aha MoMo okurabira omu Flutterwave, n'abakasitoma abu otashashuriire kuranga.
strings.ops.p.deep_links_that_open: Link ezirikwigura app yaawe n'aha kutoorwa n'aha kusiga byaijwiremu. Titurikworeka omuhendo ogu tutabariire omu mushana, kandi omuhanda gw'okubara gushohoziibwe.
strings.langNote: Ebyahandiikirwe hataine omukyebezi orikugamba orurimi bigarukira aha Rungyereza ahu ekigambo kiburire. Tuhwere kumaraho orwawe.
strings.ui.reviewNote: Ebyahindurwa bikahandiikwa UG kandi byakyeberwa omurundi gwa kabiri; okukyebera kw'abarikugamba orurimi kukyayigwire. Ebigambo ebiburire bigarukira aha Rungyereza.
